salon_info.name: Urban Trim & Groom Barber Salon
salon_info.tagline: Premium Grooming & Styling for Modern Men and Women
salon_info.address: Shop 14, Main Market, Model Town, Jalandhar, Punjab

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 1 hour before scheduled appointment time.
policies.walk_in_policy: Walk-ins are welcome, but pre-booked appointments have priority.

services.name: Classic Gentleman Haircut
services.description: Consultation, precision scissor/clipper haircut, neck cleanup, and light styling.

services.name: Skin Fade / Taper Fade
services.description: Graduated fade using zero guard, foils, and detailed razor edge lineup.

services.name: Royal Beard Trim & Sculpt
services.description: Beard length shaping, hot towel treatment, straight razor cheek lineup, and organic beard oil.

services.name: Traditional Hot Towel Wet Shave
services.description: Pre-shave oil, two hot steam towels, rich lather, single-blade razor shave, and cooling aftershave balm.

services.name: Signature Haircut + Beard Combo
services.description: Complete haircut of your choice + beard sculpting + quick relaxing scalp massage.

services.name: Detan & Charcoal Face Clean-Up
services.description: Deep-cleansing charcoal scrub, steam, blackhead removal, tan removal pack, and hydrating moisturizer.

services.name: Revitalizing Anti-Dandruff Hair Spa
services.description: Scalp detox cream application, ozonized steam infusion, relaxing massage, and nourishing mask.

services.name: Beard & Hair Color / Grey Blending
services.description: Ammonia-free organic color application providing natural-looking shade and scalp nourishment.

faqs.question: What are your opening and closing timings?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Saturday to Sunday from 8:30 AM to 9:30 PM.

faqs.question: Do I need to book in advance or can I walk in?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are always welcome, but we strongly recommend booking in advance through this assistant to skip the queue during peak evening and weekend hours.

faqs.question: How much does a haircut cost?
faqs.answer: Our Classic Gentleman Haircut is ₹250, and our Skin Fade / Taper Fade is ₹350. You can also get the Signature Haircut + Beard Combo for ₹450.

faqs.question: Can I choose my favorite barber?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can choose among our master stylists: Vikram Singh (Fade & Beard Specialist), Rahul Sharma (Modern Styling & Hair Spa), or Amit Verma (Skin & Shave Specialist).

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash, all UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and Credit/Debit cards.

faqs.question: How do I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
faqs.answer: You can reschedule or cancel anytime by chatting with this assistant. Just type 'cancel my appointment' or provide your registered phone number. Cancellations are free up to 1 hour before your slot.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the salon?
faqs.answer: Yes, dedicated two-wheeler and four-wheeler parking is available right in front of the salon at Shop 14, Main Market, Model Town.

faqs.question: What hygiene and sanitization measures do you follow?
faqs.answer: All metallic shears and razor heads are sterilized in UV autoclaves between clients. Disposable neck strips, fresh towels, and fresh single-use blades are used for every service.
